blocking_findings.finding: QRY-003 emits ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS_CHOICE, but the closed abstention vocabulary defines ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS_INTENT instead. Tie behavior therefore lacks a valid deterministic receipt code.

The repair rejects only unknown relations or empty consumer lists. A relation can still name a query, validator, or view as a consumer without a finite fixture proving that removing the relation changes retrieval, explanation, diagnosis, validation, invalidation, abstention, or next action.

surviving_mutants.mutant: decorative relation with a non-empty but behaviorally inert consumer declaration
surviving_mutants.required_kill: For every retained relation, require a finite mutation witness showing an observable output or validation delta when its edge is removed or changed.
Normalize QRY-003 to the declared ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS_INTENT code or add ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS_CHOICE to the closed vocabulary with clearing criteria.
